name: Relays and contactors
summary: Electrically operated switches: small relays, car relays, solid-state relays and big contactors.
uses: Switching heavy loads from a small signal
Low-voltage battery cutoffs and changeover switching
Switching vehicle and RV lights and pumps
identify: Clear or black boxes with four to eight pins on appliance and control boards; cube-shaped car relays (12V, 30–40A); big contactors with chunky terminals in AC units, pumps and control panels. The coil voltage is printed on the side.
test: Feed the coil its rated voltage: it should click, and the contacts should switch on a continuity test.
